risk_note: RV2 by path (platform/config, platform/crypto). Adds the second field keyring for the prior-identity store (PRIOR_IDENTITY_KEY_PROVIDER / _KEYRING_FILE / _MASTER_KEY_FILE), same rules as FIELD_*, and provides PRIOR_IDENTITY_FIELD_CRYPTO. Per D10-324 / D10-325 (option b): in staging / prod a missing group is a loadConfig problem and startup fails (listed after the FIELD problems); when FIELD_KEY_PROVIDER itself is unset no extra PRIOR problem is reported; a hand-built AppConfig without priorIdentityKeyring provides nothing and raises nothing; the two keyrings may not share a data key (compared with timingSafeEqual, then zeroed); none of the second keyring's keys reach logs or errors. Frozen fixtures were synced first by the guard-change PR #1517. Unit tests config.test.ts / admin-auth.test.ts only gain the variables, except the [AC-B1-01f] whole-config toEqual whose expectation gains the contract's priorIdentityKeyring entry. Staging / prod key files are configured by the owner before redeploy. No contract, schema or migration. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36) in two rounds (round 2 back to decision ②), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
